# Forecasting and Time Series

> Forecast daily demand with a backtest behind every number, and hand the planner a fan chart they can act on. SDAIA Academy course DS-304, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 24,068 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Look, frame and set the floor](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day1.md): From a planner's request to a series you have looked at and a floor every later method must beat; sessions: What is forecast, and why, Seeing structure, Decomposition, The benchmark floor; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day1.html; about 5,667 tokens
- [Day 2: Statistical forecasters](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day2.md): Exponential smoothing, ARIMA and regression with weather and Hijri holidays, each scored against the floor; sessions: Exponential smoothing, ARIMA-family models, Weather and moving holidays, Intervals that hold; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day2.html; about 5,444 tokens
- [Day 3: Many series and pretrained models](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day3.md): Four hundred feeders: forecasts that add up, one model for all series, and a pretrained model as a baseline; sessions: Many series and hierarchies, Global boosted forecasters, Pretrained zero-shot forecasters, Choosing among families; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day3.html; about 6,231 tokens
- [Day 4: Review and communicate](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day4.md): Review a backtest for leaks, forecast series with little history, combine methods and write the note the planner reads; sessions: Leakage across time, New and short series, Combining forecasts, Fan charts and forecast notes; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/day4.html; about 5,330 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/capstone.md): An eight-minute defence each, then four minutes of questions in which the assessor moves the forecast origin or the horizon; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/slides/capstone.html; about 1,000 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Frame three requests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D1_1_write_horizon_error.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Three time scales](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D1_2_plot_one_region.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Decompose and measure strength](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D1_3_decompose_regional_demand.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: The benchmark floor (AI-off)](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D1_4_backtest_naive_seasonal.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Exponential smoothing against the floor](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D2_1_fit_exponential_smoothing.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A seasonal ARIMA with checked residuals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D2_2_fit_seasonal_arima.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Weather and Hijri regressors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D2_3_add_temperature_hijri.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Interval coverage in the backtest](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D2_4_measure_80_95.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Feeders that add up to their region](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D3_1_fit_per_feeder.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: One boosted model across feeders](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D3_2_backtest_one_boosted.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: A pretrained forecaster, zero-shot](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D3_3_run_pretrained_forecaster.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: The scorecard](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D3_4_fill_scorecard_accuracy.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Three leaks in a backtest](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D4_1_find_three_seeded.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Feeders with eight weeks of history](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D4_2_forecast_feeder_eight.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Does the average beat the best?](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D4_3_test_whether_average.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Fan chart and planner's note](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-304/labs/D4_4_draw_fan_chart.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
